name: Request to Swap Office and Remote Days
goal: Employee requests to swap an office day with a remote day in their schedule.
constraints: Swap must maintain minimum office days per week.

phases.description: User requests to swap a specific office day with a remote day.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the dates to swap.

phases.description: User provides valid office and remote day dates.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot checks policy compliance and confirms the swap.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
